The quoted words are on the page exactly. The candidate passes the admission rule, but the date needs checking.

**The page.** It opened. It is Stanford GSB's own write-up of a *View From The Top* podcast episode (by Jenny Luna, dated June 17, 2022), followed by a "Full Transcript" of Pichai talking with MBA student Archana Sohmshetty. The quote is in Pichai's own turn in that transcript, word for word apart from the curly apostrophe in "it'll". The page is a transcript, not just news coverage of what he said.

**The date.** The page gives only June 17, 2022, the date it was published. It does not say when the conversation took place; it says only that he "visited Stanford" and was interviewed on campus "this year". The search run's date of 2022-04-22 comes from a search-result listing of the event page, which was never opened, and I did not see that date anywhere on the page. The words were said on or before 2022-06-17. Someone should confirm the event date before `date_said` is set, because the decade span runs from that date.

**Part 1 (role):** Passes. On either date he was chief executive of Google and Alphabet, which builds frontier models and its own AI chips (TPUs).

**Part 2 (looks forward, about AI):** Passes. "It" is AI: the student asked how to think about AI helping or harming humanity, and his answer is about Google going "AI first". Saying AI "will profoundly transform pretty much every sector" and will "take a decade … to fully play out" is a forecast of what AI will do. It is not a business forecast or a hypothetical.

**Part 3 (a date or length of time):** Passes. "A decade" is a span counted from the day it was said, so it would be due at the end of 2032 if the April date holds. "Still take a decade" is close to the "it will take at least a decade" wording in ruled reading 2.

**Part 4 (primary source):** Passes, because the source is a published transcript.

**Recorded already?** No. None of his recorded claim files is from 2022-04 or covers this claim. The only 2022 file is the YouTube auto-chapters goal.

**Something to flag for whoever writes the record.** "Fully play out" names no test an outsider could check, so this claim will probably be marked `unfalsifiable` when the test is written. That is decided at entry and does not affect admission. It is also unclear whether the decade applies to every sector or only to healthcare, so the prediction should keep his words.
